COMPONENT.Title: Bardcode Generator
COMPONENT.Description: Read or write barcodes of different types, supported: AZTEC,CODABAR,CODE_39,CODE_93,CODE_128,DATA_MATRIX,EAN_8,EAN_13,ITF,MAXICODE,PDF_417,QR_CODE,RSS_14,RSS_EXPANDED,UPC_A,UPC_E,All_1D,UPC_EAN_EXTENSION,MSI, PLESSEY,IMB,PHARMA_CODE
COMPONENT.Return: Returns the Bitmap of the read code and in turn can be saved in a folder

Action.Label: Action
Action.Description: Parameter to select between READ or WRITE

BarcodeType.Label: Barcode type
BarcodeType.Description: Parameter to select between different types of barcodes

Value.Label: Value
Value.Description: Parameter to write path of the image to read or text to generate new barcode

Width.Label: Width
Width.Description: Parameter to indicate the width of the image to read or write

Height.Label: Height
Height.Description: Parameter to indicate the height of the image to read or write

OutputPath.Label: Output path
OutputPath.Description: Parameter to indicate the output path of the bitmap to be written

OnlyBarcode.Label: OnlyBarcode
OnlyBarcode.Description: Parameter to indicate that only the barcode without text will be generated
